input_template:
Review bar and blocker criteria: ...
Finding: ...
Relevant diff hunk and context: ...
Prior-round findings and resolutions: ...

questions.name: blocking
questions.instructions: Does this finding meet the supplied review bar for blocking the change? Judge the finding against the diff and stated criteria. A blocker remains blocking even if an earlier round reported the same issue. Do not downgrade an unresolved blocker because it is a duplicate.

questions.name: same_as_prior
questions.instructions: Compare the current finding with prior-round findings and fixes. Identify the underlying issue, not wording similarity. If no prior findings are supplied, classify it as new_issue.

choices.description: A prior finding reports the same underlying issue, without a new regression.
The finding identifies a distinct issue absent from prior findings.
A prior fix introduced the issue described by this finding.
